command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

callbackPort.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server (default: 19876). Shorthand for redirectUri when only the port needs changing. Ignored if redirectUri is set.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

id.description: Stable identity used in opencode.json under vsworker.plugins, and in the CLI

source.description: npm registry package, GitHub repository, or a plugin vendored under vsworker/plugins

package.description: npm package name, required for npm and github sources

version.description: Exact version to pin, required for npm sources

ref.description: Full 40 character commit sha to pin, required for github sources

path.description: Entrypoint relative to vsworker/, for local sources. Defaults to plugins/<id>/index.ts

kind.description: Force the plugin kind instead of detecting it from the package exports

enabled.description: Include this entry in the build. Defaults to true. False removes it from the bundle entirely

defaultEnabled.description: Use this entry unless a user turns it off. Defaults to true

options.description: Options passed to the plugin, overridable per user in opencode.json

id.description: Server name. Users see it as the mcp.<id> key in opencode.json, and its tools are prefixed with it

config.description: The mcp.<id> value exactly as it would appear in opencode.json. {env:VAR} and {file:path} are substituted at runtime, relative to the global config directory

enabled.description: Include this entry in the build. Defaults to true. False removes it from the bundle entirely

defaultEnabled.description: Use this entry unless a user turns it off. Defaults to true

mcp.description: MCP servers bundled into VsWorker builds

id.description: Skill name. Must match the name in the skill's SKILL.md frontmatter

path.description: Skill source relative to vsworker/: a directory, or a .zip archive holding one. Defaults to skills/<id>, or skills/<id>.zip when that is what exists

enabled.description: Include this entry in the build. Defaults to true. False removes it from the bundle entirely

defaultEnabled.description: Use this entry unless a user turns it off. Defaults to true

skills.description: Skills bundled into VsWorker builds, vendored under vsworker/skills
